use a slim-armed sofa 2.5-3 m from the TV wall with the coffee table 40-45 cm in front, no oversized sectional
exploit the ceiling height with vertical floor-to-ceiling storage that keeps the floor free
anchor the large furniture pieces against the solid walls and keep the diagonal from the door to the window free
keep everything in front of the windows below 90 cm with sheer ceiling-hung curtains to maximize daylight

recommendations.ro: Canapeaua la 2,5–3 m de TV, măsuța la 40–45 cm de canapea; canapea cu brațe subțiri, nu colțar supradimensionat.
recommendations.en: Sofa 2.5–3 m from the TV, coffee table 40–45 cm from the sofa; a slim-armed sofa rather than an oversized corner unit.
recommendations.promptEn: use a slim-armed sofa 2.5-3 m from the TV wall with the coffee table 40-45 cm in front, no oversized sectional

recommendations.ro: Piesele mari (canapea, pat, dulap) pe pereții plini; diagonala ușă–fereastră rămâne liberă, ca un culoar natural.
recommendations.en: Large pieces (sofa, bed, wardrobe) on the solid walls; the door–window diagonal stays free as a natural walkway.
recommendations.promptEn: anchor the large furniture pieces against the solid walls and keep the diagonal from the door to the window free

recommendations.ro: Nimic mai înalt de 90 cm în fața ferestrei; draperii subțiri montate la tavan, ca lumina naturală să intre nestingherită.
recommendations.en: Nothing taller than 90 cm in front of the window; sheer curtains hung from the ceiling to let daylight in.
recommendations.promptEn: keep everything in front of the windows below 90 cm with sheer ceiling-hung curtains to maximize daylight
